newsitem.title: USA: Badger Meter, Instromet in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Badger Meter, Instromet in joint venture.

text.p: Badger Meter Inc and Instromet International said Friday they recently formed a new joint venture to market and sell the advanced gas measurement products of both parent companies in North America.

Badger/Instromet LLC will be jointly owned by both companies. Its products include turbine and rotary meters for volumetric measurement of natural gas flows; energy instruments for measuring energy flowrates in pipelines, and heating value/relative density measurements for custody transfer.
Badger Meter manufactures products using flow measurement technology and Instromet makes gas measurement products and systems.
